headline: Stellar 2Q performance

highlights: Refer to Important Disclosures at the end of this report BUY Hitachi Energy Stellar 2Q performance; Upgrade to BUY Engineering & Capital Goods  Result Update  November 13, 2026 CMP (Rs): 28,550 | TP (Rs): 34,300 Hitachi logged a strong beat in 2QFY27, with revenue surging 63.5% yoy to Rs30bn vs our estimate of Rs25.6bn, supported by strong execution and sustained demand across key segments.
Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded by 60bps yoy to 16.5%, above our estimate of 16%, driven by operating leverage, while adj PAT grew 48.3% yoy to Rs3.8bn, beating our estimate of Rs3.2bn.
Order momentum remained strong, with inflows of Rs41.2bn (+86% yoy; excluding the HVDC order) and the order book scaling up to a record Rs333.4bn (3.2x TTM revenue).
We see strong growth visibility, underpinned by the robust backlog and a promising opportunity pipeline, including 4-5 HVDC projects expected over the next 12-24 months.
valuation: Our view and valuation Following the strong Q2FY27 performance and positive outlook, we upgrade the stock to BUY from Add.
We roll forward our valuation to Sep-28E and assign target PER of 60x, resulting in a revised target price of Rs34,300 from Rs35,100.
Target Price – 12M Sep-27 Change in TP (%) (2.3) Current Reco.
